package.name: nros_runner_serial
package.description:
The `serial` runner (RFC-0119 D8): the default console for `nros monitor` and `nros flash --monitor`. Opens the serial port nros resolved for the plan (RFC-0118 D6), sets its baud rate and raw mode, streams what the board prints to stdout unmodified, and sends `--send` and stdin to the board with the plan's line ending.
A runner package of the same shape as a user's: the announcement below is what the provider scan reads, `nros-runner.toml` is read only when this provider is the one selected, and the executable speaks RFC-0119 D6.
